# Select

`LhSelect` is used to select one value from a predefined list. Supports clearable, disabled options, and keyboard navigation.

<!-- lh-types:begin (auto-generated by scripts/gen-type-docs.mjs, do not edit) -->

## Basic Usage

<DemoBlock title="Basic Usage">
  <LhSelect v-model="selected" :options="options" placeholder="Please select" />
</DemoBlock>

```vue composition
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LhSelect } from '@lh-ui/vue3'

const selected = ref('beijing')
const options = [
  { label: 'Beijing', value: 'beijing' },
  { label: 'Shanghai', value: 'shanghai' },
  { label: 'Shenzhen', value: 'shenzhen' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Basic usage -->
  <LhSelect v-model="selected" :options="options" placeholder="Please select" />
</template>
```

```vue options
<script>
import { LhSelect } from '@lh-ui/vue3'

export default {
  components: { LhSelect },
  data() {
    return {
      selected: 'beijing',
      options: [
        { label: 'Beijing', value: 'beijing' },
        { label: 'Shanghai', value: 'shanghai' },
        { label: 'Shenzhen', value: 'shenzhen' },
      ],
    }
  },
}
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Basic usage -->
  <LhSelect v-model="selected" :options="options" placeholder="Please select" />
</template>
```

## Keyboard Support

- `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` — Move highlight
- `Enter` — Confirm selection
- `Escape` — Close dropdown

## Accessibility & Popper Container

`aria-label` provides an accessible description, `name` is the native form name, and `popper-container` sets the mount container of the dropdown panel.

<DemoBlock title="Accessibility & Popper Container">
  <LhSelect v-model="demoA11y" :options="sizeOptions" aria-label="Please select a city" name="city" placeholder="aria-label & name" style="width: 240px" />
  <LhSelect v-model="demoContainer" :options="sizeOptions" popper-container="body" placeholder="Mounted to body" style="width: 240px" />
</DemoBlock>

```vue composition
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LhSelect } from '@lh-ui/vue3'

const demoA11y = ref('')
const demoContainer = ref('')
const sizeOptions = [
  { label: 'Option One', value: 'a' },
  { label: 'Option Two', value: 'b' },
  { label: 'Option Three', value: 'c' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <!-- aria-label & name -->
  <LhSelect v-model="demoA11y" :options="sizeOptions" aria-label="Please select a city" name="city" placeholder="aria-label & name" />
  <!-- Mounted to body -->
  <LhSelect v-model="demoContainer" :options="sizeOptions" popper-container="body" placeholder="Mounted to body" />
</template>
```

```vue options

  <!-- Mounted to body -->
  <LhSelect v-model="demoContainer" :options="sizeOptions" popper-container="body" placeholder="Mounted to body" />
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
|------|-------------|------|---------|
| modelValue | Bound value | `unknown` | — |
| options | Option list | `[LhSelectOption](#type-LhSelectOption)`[] | `() => []` |
| placeholder | Placeholder text (falls back to the `select.placeholder` locale message when unset) | `string` | `''` |
| disabled | Disabled state | `boolean` | `false` |
| clearable | Show clear button | `boolean` | `false` |
| size | Size | `"small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `'medium'` |
| name | — | `string` | — |
| ariaLabel | — | `string` | — |
| popperContainer | — | `string \| HTMLElement` | `'body'` |
| sx | sx quick-layout props | `SxProps` | — |

## Events

| Event | Description | Callback |
|-------|-------------|----------|
| update:modelValue | Value change | `(value: unknown) => void` |
| change | Selection changed | `(value, option) => void` |
| clear | Clear clicked | `() => void` |

## Option Type

```ts
type LhSelectOption = {
  label: string
  value: unknown
  disabled?: boolean
}
```

## Slots

| Slot  | Description | Default |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| empty | Custom empty-state content in the dropdown when no options exist | Locale message `select.noData` ("No data") |
